english.notes:
(i) See offence wordings H4530, H4531, H4532, H4533, H4534, H4535 and H4536 for offences under section 14 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
(ii) See offence wording H4540 for the summary only version of this offence which can be committed under any section in Part I of this Act except Section 14.
(iii) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
